title: stelis viridula
intro: Stelis viridula, commonly known as the green orchid, is a species of orchid native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Stelis viridula include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and combat infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic compounds, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-hyperglycemic, anti-hypertensive, and anti-ulcerogenic effects.
